description: List every organisation the authenticated user is a member of. Each entry reports the user's role, whether the org is a holding (is_holding, derived from its holding entitlement), and which org is currently active for this MCP session (is_active=true). parent_organization_id holds the parent organisation's ID for a child organisation, and null otherwise; parent_relation says what kind of child it is: 'client' (client tenant of a service provider) or 'subsidiary' (subsidiary of a holding), null for an organisation without a parent.
name: list_organizations
